readExpr: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('#console_input'); i.value = 'MONITOR'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); return 'monitor sent'; })()
